title: Is it a fact family? (`family-check`) and the word-work sentence layout

template.also: The same card covers the word-work `sentence` layout (`js/modules/sheet/cells/word-work.js` with payload `layout: 'sentence'`, set by `js/modules/word-work.js` for the eight within-10 / within-20 story skills) and the graphic-library entries both draw from (`js/modules/sheet/graphics/`: factTriangle, sentenceFrame, answerArea, partWholeBar, familyChart). `screen-cell.js` draws the same cells on the practice card, online worksheet and quiz

summary: Two K-2 cells rebuilt in the visual-quality lane (design/audit/VISUAL_QUALITY.md 4.4). `family-check`: the three numbers in the library's fact triangle, the whole on top, and the printed words Yes / No the pupil circles (one decision, one slot); option `familyChart` adds a blank number-family chart as working space. The word-work `sentence` layout: a story within 10 or 20 answered in one number sentence `[ ] (sign) [ ] = [ ] unit`, the part-whole bar on teaching pages. Paper, key and the three screen hosts are one drawing.
teaches: Is it a fact family? (1.OA.B.4, 1.OA.B.3; WRM Y1.B2.S13, Y2.B2.S3): do the two small numbers make the big number? Non-examples dealt 1:1 (P-10). Addition and subtraction stories within 10 and within 20 (1.OA.A.1, K.OA.A.2; WRM Y1 / Y2 add and subtract): write the number sentence and the answer with its unit.
research: From repo sources (design/audit/VISUAL_QUALITY.md c-research section 1-2: the US fact-triangle convention, the K-2 story number sentence; PEDAGOGY_STANDARD FF-6, P-10; design/PROBLEM_TYPES.md AS rows). MW4K / IXL logins not used this round (budget); the owner's sample workbooks outrank them.
problemTypes: family-check: three numbers in a triangle, the largest at the top; circle Yes if the two small numbers make the big one, No if not (non-examples: a near miss by 1 or 2, a number bigger than the whole)
family-check + familyChart: the same item with a blank four-sentence family chart to fill in while deciding (working space; the key fills it for a true family)
sentence layout: an add or take-away story within 10 / 20; write the two numbers, the sign in the circle and the answer with its unit (the bar drawn on teaching pages)
_plain story skills: the same stories with no picture row; the sentence and the answer place unchanged
progression: family-check with the chart on (the pupil writes the facts, then decides) -> the chart off (decide by adding the two small numbers)
stories within 10 with pictures -> within 10 plain -> within 20 with pictures -> within 20 plain (one change a step, P-1)
the part-whole bar on the model, guided and lesson pages; on practice pages only when the teacher turns it on

drawing.sizes: fact triangle side 34 / 42 / 50 mm (S / M / L), 1.5 pt outline, numbers at the working digit size 16 / 22 / 28 pt; Yes / No at text size + 6 pt, 12 mm apart, the key ring 1.5 pt; family chart boxes 14 x 11 / 14.3 x 13 / 17 x 15 mm (answer-area boxes, 2 digits), 0.75 pt, rows 1.6 mm apart; sentence boxes the same answer-area boxes, the sign circle 9 / 11 / 13 mm (`js/modules/sheet/graphics/*`).
notes: family-check payload: `nums` (as shown), `whole`, `parts`, `isFamily`, `labels` ['Yes','No'], `correct` 0 | 1, `chart` (familyChart on), `op` ('+'; '*' reserved for a multiplication family, none dealt today).

One graded slot: the Yes / No pair (`data-ws-slot=answer`, shape choice). The chart's twelve boxes are `data-ws-graded="0"` on paper and `input.mq-wwork` with no `data-mq-expect` on screen: typeable, never graded, never marked green (a green box would give the decision away).

Placement with the chart: S under the triangle (cell 61 mm wide, two across: 4 a page); M and L beside the triangle, the triangle and Yes / No on the left (one wide cell a row: 3 a page). The triangle never shrinks; without the chart S / M / L hold 12 / 9 / 6.
Key: Yes or No ringed; for a true family the chart's four facts written (a + b = w, b + a = w, w - a = b, w - b = a); a false family leaves the chart blank.
Screen twin: the triangle the same SVG, Yes / No buttons >= 44 px (`data-mq-choice`, screen-cell.js wireTickBoxes), the chart wraps under the triangle on a phone card.

openQuestions.q: familyChart default: off (lead's interim) or on for fact_family_sort?
openQuestions.recommended: Off: the decision is the skill; the chart is extra help the teacher turns on.

openQuestions.q: With the chart on at M / L the chart sits beside the triangle (3 a page) rather than under it (2 a page with a 24-36 % empty band). Keep beside?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes: beside reads look -> work -> decide left to right, and keeps H13 under 30 %.

openQuestions.q: Should the chart also appear on the model / lesson pages of fact_family_sort when the option is off?
openQuestions.recommended: No, and not when it is on either (built, critic r2 N1): the lesson packet draws the bare family-check cell on every frame - the chart is practice-page working space, and beside the model it pushed the step column off the sheet. Every other role honours the option.

openQuestions.q: Part-whole bar on practice pages (interim: option, default off; drawn on teaching pages). Confirm?
openQuestions.recommended: Confirm: the bar is the model's picture; on practice it is a support the teacher adds and fades.
